channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Quinn | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Quinn from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Chris Quinn
item.description:
Tyler Herro says it's all love with the Miami Heat:

“It's all love in Miami. I've seen a couple of the guys, coaching staff. Chris Quinn, Spo. We're all good in Miami and an opportunity for both sides to reset and get a fresh start. We're both super happy for this.”

Tyler Herro on Chris Quinn, Jul 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dan Bisaccio on Chris Quinn, Juwan Howard, Caron Butler, Malik Allen, Dan Craig
item.description:
Bisaccio, 34, spent last season as a Heat player development coach and has spent the past three weeks as the Heat’s summer league head coach.

“I’ve been a part of a variety of different coaches and different summer leagues — Dan Craig, Juwan Howard, Chris Quinn, Malik Allen and most recently Caron Butler,”

Dan Bisaccio on Chris Quinn, Juwan Howard, Caron Butler, Malik Allen, Dan Craig, Jul 22, 2024. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Chris Quinn
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Chris Quinn filling in as head coach on Saturday:

“He has the full trust of everybody.... This is something that he has been developing for several years.”

Erik Spoelstra on Chris Quinn, Mar 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.
